subject: Temporary waiver request: cold-standby RTO/RPO commitment (Greenleaf)
messages:
From: Tim Burke <tim.burke@greenleaf.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenleaf Platform Ops <ops@greenleaf.io>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SLA waiver for cold-standby during migration

Hi Rishi,

Quick background: were about to migrate a legacy analytics shard into our long-term cold-archive. That migration requires a short window where we cannot afford a full warm standby in eu-west-1. Were asking Redwood to temporarily accept a cold-standby arrangement for our east-us region for up to 90 days while we complete the migration cutover.

Current ask: allow an interim RTO of 6 hours (instead of our signed 1 hour) and RPO of 4 hours for the east-us failover path during the 90-day window. This would be scoped to the Greenleaf production cluster only (cluster-id: gl-prod-01), with activation restricted to the documented maintenance window and with agreed compensating controls (extra snapshot cadence, extended monitoring, and a rollback runbook).

Wed like a written acknowledgement for procurement and our board notes, plus a simple DocuSign addendum if feasible. I attached our DR matrix and included a short appendix describing why warm standby is not possible for this shard.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of next steps and what Redwood needs from our side to evaluate.

Thanks,
Tim
Tim Burke
Head of Platform Operations
Greenleaf Financial
[Attachment: greenleaf-dr-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Burke <tim.burke@greenleaf.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA waiver for cold-standby during migration

Hi Tim — thanks for the details and the DR matrix. We can support a temporary waiver in principle, but need internal approvals and a formal addendum with explicit conditions.

High-level checklist Im taking to my team today:
- Confirm scope: cluster gl-prod-01 only, east-us region (no cross-region reduction).
- Duration: 90 days max with a 30-day review cadence.
- Compensating controls you listed (snapshots every 4 hours, dedicated on-call, runbook) must be operational before waiver activation.
- We will require a quarterly DR test within 60 days after the migration completes.

Im looping in Aditya (sales lead) and Laura (legal) to confirm contract/approval path and any financial/credit treatment for increased operational risk. Ill follow up with a draft PDF waiver for signature and an internal note for our ops/SRE team.

Can you confirm youll enable 4-hour snapshot cadence and provide the last three snapshot IDs once enabled? That will speed approvals.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: temporary SLA waiver for cold-standby during migration

Aditya / Laura — forwarding Tims ask. Summary: Greenleaf (deal GF-2026-0612) requests a 90-day temporary waiver to move a shard to cold-archive; they need RTO 6h / RPO 4h for east-us during migration window. Theyre proposing compensating controls (4-hour snapshots, on-call, rollback runbook). Theyre ready to sign a DocuSign addendum.

Open questions Id like cleared quickly:
- Financial: do we treat this as a one-time operational risk credit? Any standard language we use for temporary carve-outs?
- Legal: minimum required language for an addendum; any liability caps we need to preserve?
- Ops: can we scope the waiver to a single cluster and single region without affecting other Greenleaf assets?

Im attaching a short draft waiver (redwood-temp-sla-waiver-v1.pdf) I prepared to speed the process. If youre good, Id like to get a signed copy in 48–72 hours.

Thanks — Rishi
[Attachment: redwood-temp-sla-waiver-v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: temporary SLA waiver for cold-standby during migration

Rishi — reviewed. Im okay approving a provisional 90-day waiver under the following conditions:
1) Waiver limited to cluster gl-prod-01 in east-us only; no other clusters or regions included.
2) Customer must enable 4-hour snapshots and provide confirmation (3 snapshot IDs) before waiver effective date.
3) We require a weekly sync for the first 30 days and a 30-day review to either close, extend (with exec sign-off), or remediate back to standard SLA.
4) Addendum will include an explicit RTO/RPO table, compensating controls, and a clause stating Redwood retains the right to terminate the waiver if compensating controls are not demonstrably in place.
5) Financial: no upfront credits; operational risk will be handled by a one-time professional services fee to cover SRE runbook support (proposed $5,000). Sales to discuss credits separately if needed.

Laura — please confirm legal language on clause (4) and any required indemnity language. If legal signs off, Ill authorize Rishi to send the addendum for signature and we can schedule the weekly sync.

-Aditya
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Burke <tim.burke@greenleaf.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA waiver for cold-standby during migration

Tim — thanks for the patience. Were prepared to move forward with a provisional 90-day waiver under the internal conditions below (copied from Aditya):
- Scope: gl-prod-01, east-us only.
- RTO during waiver: 6 hours; RPO: 4 hours.
- Preconditions: you must enable 4-hour snapshot cadence and share three recent snapshot IDs before the waiver effective date.
- Controls & cadence: weekly sync for first 30 days; 30-day formal review. Failure to maintain controls allows Redwood to revoke the waiver.
- Financial: one-time SRE support fee of $5,000 to cover runbook support; no automatic credit.

I attached the draft addendum (redwood-temp-sla-waiver-v1.pdf) with the RTO/RPO table and termination clause. Laura, please let us know any edits. Tim, if you confirm you can produce the three snapshot IDs and approve the runbook items, Ill send the DocuSign route and target signature within 48 hours.

Next steps for Greenleaf:
1) Enable 4-hour snapshots and reply with 3 snapshot IDs.
2) Review and sign the addendum (DocuSign link to follow).
3) Join weekly check-ins starting the week waiver goes into effect.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
